recent_posts.title: Introductory Guide to the Interoperable Building Box (IBB)
recent_posts.summary: The Interoperable Building Box (IBB) is a cloud-native technology that aims to streamline integration and enhance efficiency in the smart buildings industry. It provides a standardized interface to connect a building's local network to the Internet Cloud, allowing for greater connectivity, communication, and control. The IBB consists of three main parts: Operating System (OS), Administration, and IBB Apps. By leveraging containerization and cloud-native architecture, the IBB simplifies the installation, configuration, and management of applications, making them more secure, reliable, and compatible. Ultimately, the IBB aims to create a collaborative ecosystem that revolutionizes the automation industry and meets the expectations of stakeholders.
